title: Online Modeling and Sequential Convex Programming for Lunar Landing Trajectory Optimization
summary: This paper presents a guidance framework for lunar powered descent and landing that combines sequential convex programming (SCP) with real-time online model identification. A nonconvex energy-optimal landing problem is developed and then reformulated into a sequence of convex second-order cone programs (SOCPs) through a change of variables, successive linearization, and a lossless second-order cone relaxation of the thrust direction constraint.
